blurb: Nevada Dance Workshop offers dance classes for all ages and abilities, including ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, and contemporary. They provide summer dance workshops such as Disney Camps for ages 3-5, Classical Ballet Workshops for ages 6+, and Mixed Styles Workshops. The studio emphasizes professional faculty, performance opportunities, and a supportive community environment.
